title: Impact of Situation in Myanmar on ASEAN's Unity
what_it_is: Impact of Situation in Myanmar on ASEAN's Unity

sections.label: ASEAN Myanmar Five-Point Consensus
sections.summary: ASEAN reaffirmed the Five-Point Consensus and Leaders' decisions, with little progress, and Singapore will work with ASEAN to press the Tatmadaw.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Foreign Affairs (Ms Sim Ann) (for the Minister for Foreign Affairs)
sentences.text: The ASEAN Leaders reviewed the situation at their Summits in 2022 and 2023 and agreed on a series of steps to send a clear signal to the Myanmar military or Tatmadaw.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Foreign Affairs (Ms Sim Ann) (for the Minister for Foreign Affairs)
sentences.text: At the ASEAN Foreign Ministers' Retreat last week, ASEAN reaffirmed its commitment to the Five-Point Consensus as well as the Leaders' decisions.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Foreign Affairs (Ms Sim Ann) (for the Minister for Foreign Affairs)
sentences.text: There has been little progress in the implementation of the Five-Point Consensus and, in fact, the situation in Myanmar has become more dire of late.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Foreign Affairs (Ms Sim Ann) (for the Minister for Foreign Affairs)
sentences.text: However, the rate-limiting factor for progress is not ASEAN, but the Tatmadaw.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Foreign Affairs (Ms Sim Ann) (for the Minister for Foreign Affairs)
sentences.text: Singapore will continue to work with ASEAN's Chair Laos, fellow ASEAN Member States and our external partners to press the Tatmadaw to cease violence and implement the Five-Point Consensus swiftly and fully.

sections.label: Myanmar security and humanitarian support
sections.summary: The security situation remains dire, almost a civil war, and ASEAN expects Thailand to facilitate cross-border humanitarian assistance.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
sentences.text: If the Member checks with his contacts there, the security situation remains dire.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
sentences.text: It is almost tantamount to a civil war.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
sentences.text: So, the other point which we have all emphasised is that there is a need to continue humanitarian support.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
sentences.text: And ASEAN is engaged on this and we are also expecting that Thailand will do a bit more to enable or facilitate the cross-border delivery of humanitarian assistance.

sections.label: Myanmar political leaders reconciliation
sections.summary: Myanmar's political leaders across the spectrum need to reconcile and hold direct face-to-face negotiations in good faith.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
sentences.text: The political leaders across the spectrum in Myanmar need to get together, reconcile their diverse positions and we still believe there needs to be direct face-to-face negotiations conducted in good faith amongst all the political leaders there.
